mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime constraints.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive 20-day returns occur in less than 55% of easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: Joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) signals imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime constraints.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1400.0 thousand units signals weakening housing market conditions, which precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1400.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate combined with stable federal funds rate (no rate cut) signals labor market deterioration without monetary policy support, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during policy inaction.
regime_hint: monetary policy inaction during labor deterioration
failure_condition: Joint condition of rising UNRATE and stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: High real GDP level (GDPC1 above 95th percentile) indicates strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during robust expansion phases.
failure_condition: In strong economic expansion phases (GDPC1 > 95th percentile), 60-day forward returns are positive in <60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.
